cap: Sex is five questions, not one. Genotypic sex is the karyotype, fixed at fertilization; gonadal sex is testis or ovary; phenotypic sex is the body that hormones build; gender identity is a person's inner sense of being a woman, a man or another gender; and sexual orientation is whom the person is attracted to. In complete androgen insensitivity a 46,XY karyotype sits beside a female body.
teach: A disorder of sex development moves one layer without moving the others: the 46,XY karyotype stays, the testes made hormones, but a defective androgen receptor means the phenotype is female. Gender identity and sexual orientation cannot be read from the karyotype, the gonads or the anatomy, so the clinician asks.
